settings.label: Delivery

options.label: Real e-mail (server configured: Resend or SMTP)

settings.help: Real delivery is configured on the server only (RESEND_API_KEY or IAM_SMTP_*), never here. Until it is, this method stays simulated.

authMethod.name: One-time code by e-mail
authMethod.description: Sends a short code to the user's e-mail address and asks for it. In this POC the e-mail goes to a DEMO OUTBOX visible to administrators: no real e-mail is sent, so it proves nothing about possession of a mailbox.

mailTemplates.name: Sign-in code
mailTemplates.description: Sent when a user signs in with the one-time e-mail code method.

default.subject: Your sign-in code: {{code}}
default.text:
Hello {{subjectUser}},

Your sign-in code is {{code}}. It expires in {{ttlMinutes}} minutes. If you did not try to sign in, ignore this message.
default.html:
Hello {{subjectUser}},

Your sign-in code:

{{code}}

This code expires in {{ttlMinutes}} minutes. If you did not try to sign in, ignore this message.
